title: Evening rundown & one-off TODOs
body:
Notes to self - quick dump (evening)

Top priorities (tomorrow AM):
- 09:00 - triage batcher memory spike (suspect: KV cache growth). run lightweight repro on dev rig, capture heap profile. ~1.5h
- PR review: #987 - quantized kernel fallback. check perf numbers against perf-bench10; leave inline comments. ~30m
- Prep demo for Fri - focus on graceful degradation: plan fallback chain (gptx-small -> gptx-quant -> hosted-fallback), create slides (3) + script. Ask Ops for access to dedicated test slot. ~2h

Quick work errands / reminders:
- Add canary rollout stage to the deployment manifest: add trafficPercent=10, probing window 120s. ticket JIRA-4321.
- Follow up with Priya re: console tracing hooks — ask for sample trace id from last outage.
- Confirm prod KMS rotation window with infra (email Tomas).

Personal errand + tiny things:
- Drop off bike at AeroCycle for tune-up (Thu morning)
- Buy cat food (RoyalCanin, 2x bags) - add pickup to tomorrow lunch run
- Dentist appointment reminder: Apr 3, 11:30am - put on calendar
- Water office plant (succulent) Wednesday & Saturday

Scratch ideas (braindump - ephemeral):
- Try a short eval harness that measures token-level latency tail vs prefix length distribution; feed real route logs -> synthesize seq length histogram -> run microbench. Could feed into Optimize suggestions.
- Tiny experiment: test stop-token behavior when streaming chunk size = 64 vs 256. Use prompt set 'stop-test-1' in /tmp. Hypothesis: smaller chunks reduces perceived latency but may miss final token-leading stop detection.
- If memory spike recurring, consider K/V eviction policy: LRU cap + soft TTL for prompts > 2048 tokens.

Meeting prep notes (1:1 w/ Angela):
- Progress on dedicated capacity onboarding, blockers: VPC peering docs unclear, need sample helm values for private deploy.
- Request: more headcount for infra automation (1 SRE contractor) to hit Q2 SLAs.
- Bring up FYI: customer X asked for region failover test — schedule with Solutions Eng.

Unresolved questions / quick TODOs: (tick when done)
- [ ] repro memory spike and attach profile to JIRA-4321
- [ ] leave PR comments on #987
- [ ] send demo invite to ops@redwood (cc: Priya)
- [ ] confirm KMS rotation window w/ Tomas
- [ ] buy cat food on Thu

Random short reminders:
- Bike lock code (don't store here, ephemeral) - memorize tonight
- Pack demo laptop charger
- Quick gratitude: good day, small wins on perf tuning

If stuck tomorrow: 1) re-run minimal repro locally, 2) ping Noah for fresh eyes, 3) escalate to oncall if tail latency > 500ms for curated route.

End of dump. Revisit in AM, prune, convert items to tickets where needed.
